title: Anna and Tom at Work
text:
My name is Anna. I am a doctor. I work in a big hospital in Warsaw. I help sick people every day. I start work at eight in the morning.

My friend Tom is a teacher. He works at a school near my house. He teaches English to children. He likes his job because the children are happy. He finishes work at three o'clock.

questions.text: What kind of person is Anna probably?
How does Tom probably feel about his work?

vocabulary.definition: a person who treats sick people
a place where sick people receive medical care
a person who teaches in a school

paragraph_translations: Mam na imię Anna. Jestem lekarzem. Pracuję w dużym szpitalu w Warszawie. Każdego dnia pomagam chorym ludziom. Zaczynam pracę o ósmej rano.
Mój przyjaciel Tom jest nauczycielem. Pracuje w szkole niedaleko mojego domu. Uczy angielskiego dzieci. Lubi swoją pracę, ponieważ dzieci są szczęśliwe. Kończy pracę o trzeciej po południu.
